text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I can't believe we beat thirty of them!
I'd better work hard to keep up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わー！　
30勝しちゃうなんてすごいです！
私も負けません！

text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.text: To protect everyone's smiles, I'll do my best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなの笑顔を守るために、
ウヅキ
頑張ります！
